- Anything you couldn't do or decided differently from this brief, and why.

Stop when the change and tests are in the working tree and you've reported. Don't commit.

    def retract_shot(self, user_id: str, shot_id: str) -> bool:
        """Undo: a retraction record (deleted = true), never a delete. Retracting twice writes once."""
        prev = self._owned(self.shots, shot_id, user_id)
        if prev is None:
            raise NotFound(shot_id)
        if prev.deleted:
            return False
        self._commit(self.shots, shot_id, prev.item, "shots", deleted=True)
        return True

    def restore_shot(self, user_id: str, shot_id: str) -> bool:
        """Undo a retraction: the shot again, as a new record. Restoring a shot that's there writes nothing."""
        prev = self._owned(self.shots, shot_id, user_id)
        if prev is None:
            raise NotFound(shot_id)
        if not prev.deleted:
            return False
        self._commit(self.shots, shot_id, prev.item, "shots")
        return True

    def save_equipment(self, user_id: str, data: dict) -> Equipment:
        """Add or change equipment. One default per kind: making this one the default clears the others.
        A change keeps what the body leaves out (notes, a model the form doesn't show, retired), so editing a
        grinder made elsewhere doesn't erase its notes and saving a retired one doesn't bring it back."""
        data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k != "user_id"}
        prev = self._owned(self.equipment, str(data.get("equipment_id") or ""), user_id)
        if prev:
            kept = prev.item.model_dump(exclude={"user_id"})
            data = {k: v for k, v in kept.items() if k not in data} | data
        item = Equipment(**data, user_id=user_id)
        if prev and prev.item.kind != item.kind:
            raise Invalid("Equipment can't change kind. Add a new one instead.")
        if item.retired:
            item = item.model_copy(update={"is_default": False})
        if not (prev and prev.item == item):
            self._commit(self.equipment, item.equipment_id, item, "equipment")
        if item.is_default:
            for other in self.equipment_of(user_id, item.kind):
                if other.equipment_id != item.equipment_id and other.is_default:
                    self._commit(
                        self.equipment,
                        other.equipment_id,
                        other.model_copy(update={"is_default": False}),
                        "equipment",
                    )
        return item

    def save_bag(self, user_id: str, data: dict) -> tuple[Bag, list[dict]]:
        """A bag typed by hand: matched to the catalog the same way a typed shot is."""
        bag = Bag(**{k: v for k, v in data.items() if k != "user_id"}, user_id=user_id)
        prev = self._owned(self.bags, bag.bag_id, user_id)
        # Today in UTC plus a day's grace (the phone checks the same), so no zone's "today" is refused. Only a date
        # being set now is refused, so a bag stored before this check (with a future date) can still take its photo's
        # match.
        new_date = not (prev and prev.item.roast_date == bag.roast_date)
        if new_date and bag.roast_date and bag.roast_date > datetime.now(UTC).date() + timedelta(days=1):
            raise Invalid("That roast date is in the future. Check the year.")
        same_text = prev and (prev.item.coffee_freetext or "").strip() == (bag.coffee_freetext or "").strip()
        if prev and same_text and not bag.coffee_id:
            # A resend or an edit of something else keeps the match; changed text is matched again below.
            bag = bag.model_copy(
                update={"coffee_id": prev.item.coffee_id, "match_score": prev.item.match_score}
            )
        matches: list[dict] = []
        if not bag.coffee_id and bag.coffee_freetext:
            coffee_id, matches = shots.match_coffee(bag.coffee_freetext, self.lake)
            score = matches[0]["score"] if coffee_id else None
            bag = bag.model_copy(update={"coffee_id": coffee_id, "match_score": score})
        opened = bag.opened_on or (prev.item.opened_on if prev else None) or date.today()
        bag = bag.model_copy(update={"opened_on": opened})
        if not (prev and prev.item == bag):
            self._commit(self.bags, bag.bag_id, bag, "bags")
        return bag, matches

@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
    def today(request: Request, me: Me) -> HTMLResponse:
        p = store.prefill(me.user_id, bag_id=request.cookies.get("selected_bag"))
        bag, last = p["bag"], p["last"]
        if not bag and not last:
            return page(request, "first_run.html", me=me, grinder=p["grinder"], basket=p["basket"])
        name, facts = coffee_name(bag, p["coffee_id"], p["coffee_freetext"])
        pulled = store.bag_shots(me.user_id, bag, last)
        z = tz(request)
        prev = pulled[-2] if len(pulled) > 1 else None
        return page(
            request,
            "today.html",
            open_bags=[b for b in store.bags_of(me.user_id) if not b.finished_on],
            p=p,
            name=name,
            facts=facts,
            shots=pulled,
            earlier=list(reversed(pulled[:-1]))[:3],
            target=views.target_svg(pulled) if pulled else "",
            summary=views.summary(pulled[-1], prev, z) if pulled else "",
            me=me,
            grinder_of=lambda s: store.gear(me.user_id, s.grinder_id),
            days_off=(datetime.now(z).date() - bag.roast_date).days if bag and bag.roast_date else None,
            day=lambda d: views.day(d, z),
            clock=lambda d: views.clock(d, z),
            # "7:06" today, "Sun 14:04" on an earlier day
            when=lambda d: (
                views.clock(d, z) if d.astimezone(z).date() == datetime.now(z).date() else views.day(d, z)
            ),
        )

    @app.get("/bags/switch", response_class=HTMLResponse)
    def switch_bag(request: Request, me: Me) -> HTMLResponse:
        bags = [b for b in store.bags_of(me.user_id) if not b.finished_on]

        lines = [bag_line(b, []) for b in bags]

    @app.get("/bag/{bag_id}/use")
    def use_bag(request: Request, bag_id: str, me: Me, next: str = "today") -> RedirectResponse:
        bag = store.bag(me.user_id, bag_id)
        if not bag or bag.finished_on:
            raise HTTPException(404, "no such open bag")
        response = RedirectResponse("/log" if next == "log" else "/", status_code=303)
        response.set_cookie(
            "selected_bag",
            bag.bag_id,
            max_age=365 * 24 * 3600,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=request.url.scheme == "https",
        )
        return response

## Components #### Field row Label above, numeral and unit below, steppers on the right. Values come from the last shot of the bag; the app never changes one on its own and doesn't suggest a different grind. Long-press on a stepper repeats after 400 ms, every 80 ms. Tapping the numeral opens a numeric keypad. A left-hand setting mirrors the steppers to the left edge. #### Time field px `--ink-2` line, and the newest has a ring. On the coffee page they're neither numbered nor joined. It has an `aria-label`, and the sentence under it says the same thing in words. #### Chips Outlined, 44 tall, 8 radius. Accent outline for actions ("Same as last"); `--control` outline with ink text for a picker (the grinder and basket chip). Never used for status. #### Status text Role or state after a name, in 13 px `--ink-2` with no border: "jtouley owner", "Invite from Oct 24 not used yet". #### List link A 56-tall row with a hairline below, 17 px ink text and an ink-2 chevron when it opens something. Actions that happen in place (Sign out) have no chevron. Destructive ones are `--danger`, have no chevron, and give a 5 s undo strip instead of a confirmation dialog. #### Spec sheet Two columns, label 112 px wide in `--ink-2` and value, hairline between rows. For the match card, catalog facts and nothing else. #### Text input 56 tall, 17 px text, `--sheet` background, `--control` border, 8 radius. The label sits above it and stays; hints and errors sit below in 13 px, errors in `--danger`. Focus: accent border plus a 3 px accent ring at 22%. Password fields have a 48-wide "Show" button inside. `autocomplete` is `username`, `current-password` or `new-password`, so Android's password manager fills and saves them. Errors never clear what was typed. #### Bag photo 6 radius with a 1 px inner outline so a pale bag doesn't melt into the paper. Dimmed slightly in dark mode. In the mockups it's a hatched placeholder. #### Dock The bottom area holding the primary button and at most one text button under it. Paper (or sheet) background, a 20 px fade above it where content scrolls under, safe-area padding below, no hairline. #### Navigation Three text tabs, Today, Coffees and Setup. The active one is ink, weight 600, with the accent dot above it; the others are `--ink-2`. A 20 px fade above, no hairline. Sign in, Sign up and the camera have no tabs. #### Sync status Top right: a check and "Synced", or "2 waiting to sync" in `--ink-2`. It never blocks anything. #### Undo strip `--panel`, radius 8, no border: "Shot saved" and an accent "Undo", with a thin line under Undo that shrinks over 5 s. Undo writes a retraction record. #### Edit bag An accent "Edit bag" text link (56 px tall, ending on the gutter) after the roast line on Today and on the coffee page. The form: roaster and coffee, roast date, weight, and "Still using it" / "Finished". Saving writes a new record under the same id (the shots stay with it) and returns to the screen it was opened from, with a notice. A roast date in the future isn't saved; one more than 90 days old asks "Save with day N?". #### Notice What the last save did, at the top of the screen it lands on: "Bag saved: Onyx Geometry", "DF64 V2 saved", "Correction saved", "Shot undone", "Password changed". `--panel`, radius 8, like the Undo strip; `role="status"`, so it's read out (shown empty, then filled, so screen readers announce it). A save queued offline says so: "Saved on this phone. It’ll sync when you’re back online."; a bag names itself, since Today may still show the last one until it syncs: "Bag saved on this phone: Onyx Geometry. It’ll sync when you’re back online." Logging a shot keeps Saved as its confirmation, with Undo. Every save leaves its form: it returns to the screen the form was opened from (Setup, first run, the gear picker on Log shot), stepping back in history, or else replaces the form, so Back never reopens what was just saved. ## Copy Short, plain and specific, in sentence case, with real apostrophes (’). Buttons start with a verb. The same action has the same words everywhere ("Type the coffee", never "Type it instead"). The app says what happened and leaves the next move to the owner: "Ran fast at 22 s, outside the window." "Inside the window, two seconds slower than Monday’s shot." No "go finer" or "try 11" until the dial-in model in the plan exists. Errors say what happened and what to do next, and keep what was typed: | Where | Copy | |---|---| | Sign in, wrong password or username | That username and password don’t match. Check them, or ask jtouley for a reset code. | | Sign in, locked | Too many tries. Try again in 15 minutes, or ask jtouley for a reset code. | | Sign up, code used or expired | This invite has already been used. Ask jtouley for a new one. / This invite expired on November 3. | | Sign up, username taken | Someone already has that username. Try another. | | Sign up, short password | Use at least 10 characters. | | Weak match | The bag says Larkspur, “Hambela”, roasted Oct 18. None of these is a close match, so pick the right one. | | Reading failed | The label was too dark or out of focus. Retake it with the label facing the light, or type the coffee. | | Daily read limit | You’ve used today’s 10 bag reads. Type the coffee, or try again tomorrow. | | Offline save | Saved on this phone. It’ll sync when you’re back online. | The share text for an invite: "Log your espresso shots with me on registry.coffee: app.registry.coffee/join#K7QD-M2XF-9RPA-T4WE (works once, until November 3)." ## What's not designed yet Search (from "Pick another match" and "Type the coffee"), History, the reset-code entry screen, the left-hand layout, the numeric keypad, and the offline and camera-denied states. They use the components above. - Roasters who want to be left out can open an issue. The owner records the opt-out with the "Exclude this roaster" box on the "Add a roaster" form, and the site is never fetched again. - By design, the project doesn't use directories whose terms forbid scraping, sources whose terms forbid storing their data, or sites that block bots. ## Limitations - **US only, one owner.** Discovery filters to US places. The CLI, MCP server and issue forms log shots as the owner, and the issue forms only act on the repo owner's issues. Other people use the app, by invite. - **The app is a first version.** It has no screen to edit or finish a bag. - **No hosted dataset.** You create and run your own lake; this repo doesn't link to a published copy. - **Coverage depends on the stores.** Sites that block bots or publish no machine-readable catalog show up as `unreachable`, `no_catalog` or `no_coffee` in `dim_roaster`. - **Attributes are a best guess,** by rules or by Claude. The roaster's own listing is authoritative. - **Marketplace listings** on Snowflake and Databricks need their own accounts and reviews.
